text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: On the way back from the race...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, I beg your pardon. That was rude<n>of me...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm fine. This is nothing I can't<n>handle.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It is just one more barrier I must<n>overcome... if I'm
to make it to the<n>top.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Despite what she says, Grass<n>Wonder is visibly
exhausted. I may<n>have to adjust her racing
schedule<n>for the near future.
